prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='DWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='CWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: DWT_catboost emerges as both trend and overall champion with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and lowest RMSE (31.36), while CWT_rf leads seasonality capture (0.9032). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 100.0) and split trend/seasonality champions suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition strengths across wavelet-transformed models.
